test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

It can / get extreme cold / during / the winters.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is "get extreme cold."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"get extreme cold."**
 
• The error in the original sentence is the use of** "extreme"** as an adjective instead of **"extremely"** as an adverb.
 
• In this context, you are describing the degree of coldness during winters, and** "extremely"** is the appropriate adverb to modify the adjective **"cold."**
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.

Correct sentence: *It can **get extremely cold**__ during the winters.*
